scripts.test: rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 --test-coverage-include="dist-test/src/**" --test dist-test/test/*.test.js > dist-test/coverage.txt; status=$?; cat dist-test/coverage.txt; [ $status -eq 0 ] && assert-all-covered dist-test/src dist-test/coverage.txt main.js tools/adapter.js
